spec.title: Soil Relative Wetness Index
spec.description: Experimental relative wetness index, not absolute soil moisture percentage

spec.query:
// ปรับช่วงรวมข้อมูลตาม Time Range เพื่อลดจำนวนจุดที่ส่งให้ Grafana
span = int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: v.timeRangeStart)
interval =
  if span <= int(v: 1h) then 10s
  else if span <= int(v: 1d) then 2m
  else if span <= int(v: 7d) then 15m
  else if span <= int(v: 30d) then 1h
  else v.windowPeriod

// ใช้ค่าล่าสุดของแต่ละช่วง โดยคงชื่อ Field เดิมสำหรับ Overrides
from(bucket: "plantcare")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "plantcare_soil" and
    r._field == "relative_wetness_pct" and
    r.device_id == "esp32_01" and
    r.data_source == "real"
  )
  |> aggregateWindow(
    every: interval,
    fn: last,
    createEmpty: false,
    timeSrc: "_start"
  )
  |> yield(name: "Soil Wetness")

from(bucket: "plantcare")
  |> range(start: -3m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "plantcare_soil" and
    r._field == "relative_wetness_pct" and
    r.data_source == "real" and
    r.device_id == "esp32_01"
  )
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    _field: "soil_condition",
    _value:
      if r._value < 17.0 then 0.0
      else if r._value < 20.0 then 1.0
      else if r._value < 70.0 then 2.0
      else 3.0
  }))
  |> yield(name: "soil_condition")

spec.title: AMG8833 - Thermal Pixel Matrix 8×8
spec.description: 8x8 Thermal Grid Heatmap using Grafana Built-in Table Panel

spec.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: "plantcare")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "plantcare_thermal" and
    r.data_source == "real" and
    r._field =~ /^p[0-7][0-7]$/
  )
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    row: int(v: strings.substring(v: r._field, start: 1, end: 2)),
    col: strings.substring(v: r._field, start: 2, end: 3),
    _value: r._value
  }))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["row"],
    columnKey: ["col"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> sort(columns: ["row"])
  |> drop(columns: ["row"]) // 🌟 เพิ่มบรรทัดนี้เพื่อลบคอลัมน์ row ออก

// ปรับช่วงรวมข้อมูลตาม Time Range เพื่อลดจำนวนจุดที่ส่งให้ Grafana
span = int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: v.timeRangeStart)
interval =
  if span <= int(v: 1h) then 10s
  else if span <= int(v: 1d) then 2m
  else if span <= int(v: 7d) then 15m
  else if span <= int(v: 30d) then 1h
  else v.windowPeriod

// ใช้ค่าล่าสุดของแต่ละช่วง โดยคงชื่อ Field เดิมสำหรับ Overrides
from(bucket: "plantcare")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "plantcare_thermal" and
    (r._field == "t_min_c" or
     r._field == "t_max_c") and
    r.device_id == "esp32_01" and
    r.data_source == "real"
  )
  |> aggregateWindow(
    every: interval,
    fn: last,
    createEmpty: false,
    timeSrc: "_start"
  )

  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "plantcare_soil" and

  }))

spec.title: PlantCare Historical Sensor Data
spec.description: Historical one-minute Soil and AMG8833 measurements | Latest 500 minute-level rows in the selected time range; full raw data remains in InfluxDB.

spec.query:
// อ่านเฉพาะ Field ที่จำเป็นสำหรับตารางเดิม (ไม่ดึง Pixel 64 ช่อง)
from(bucket: "plantcare")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.data_source == "real" and
    r.device_id == "esp32_01" and
    (
      (r._measurement == "plantcare_soil" and
        (r._field == "soil_adc_raw" or
         r._field == "soil_adc_filtered" or
         r._field == "relative_wetness_pct")) or
      (r._measurement == "plantcare_thermal" and
        (r._field == "t_min_c" or
         r._field == "t_max_c" or
         r._field == "t_left_c" or
         r._field == "t_right_c" or
         r._field == "delta_t_c"))
    )
  )
  // เก็บค่าล่าสุดต่อนาที จำกัดจำนวนต่อ Field ก่อน pivot
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 500)
  |> toFloat()
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["_time", "plant_id", "device_id"],
    columnKey: ["_measurement", "_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> keep(columns: [
    "_time", "plant_id", "device_id",
    "plantcare_soil_soil_adc_raw",
    "plantcare_soil_soil_adc_filtered",
    "plantcare_soil_relative_wetness_pct",
    "plantcare_thermal_t_min_c",
    "plantcare_thermal_t_max_c",
    "plantcare_thermal_t_left_c",
    "plantcare_thermal_t_right_c",
    "plantcare_thermal_delta_t_c"
  ])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 500)

spec.title: Sensor Data Connectivity
spec.description: Telemetry freshness per sensor: Disconnected when the gap since the previous sample exceeds 180 seconds. Only state transitions are plotted; this is not a direct Wi-Fi connection measurement.

spec.query:
import "date"
import "array"

// ดูข้อมูลก่อนช่วงที่เลือก 3 นาที เพื่อคำนวณสถานะ ณ จุดเริ่มต้น
start = v.timeRangeStart
stop = if v.timeRangeStop > now() then now() else v.timeRangeStop
timeout = int(v: 3m)

samples =
  from(bucket: "plantcare")
    |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3m, from: start), stop: stop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r.data_source == "real" and
      r.device_id == "esp32_01" and
      (
        (r._measurement == "plantcare_soil" and r._field == "relative_wetness_pct") or
        (r._measurement == "plantcare_thermal" and r._field == "t_max_c")
      )
    )
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_measurement"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _field: if r._measurement == "plantcare_soil" then "Soil" else "Thermal",
      _value: 1.0
    }))
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

// สถานะเริ่มต้นหากไม่พบข้อมูลภายใน 180 วินาที
baseline = array.from(rows: [
  {_time: start, _field: "Soil", _value: 0.0, priority: 1},
  {_time: start, _field: "Thermal", _value: 0.0, priority: 1}
])

// จุดแรกที่ได้รับข้อมูล หรือสถานะที่ต่อเนื่องมาจากก่อนช่วงที่เลือก
first_seen = samples
  |> first()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: if r._time < start then start else r._time,
    _field: r._field,
    _value: 1.0,
    priority: 0
  }))

// ใช้ timestamps จริงและตรวจ gap มากกว่า 180 วินาที
gaps = samples
  |> elapsed(unit: 1ns, columnName: "gap_ns")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.gap_ns > timeout)

disconnects = gaps
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: time(v: int(v: r._time) - r.gap_ns + timeout),
    _field: r._field,
    _value: 0.0,
    priority: 0
  }))

reconnects = gaps
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    _field: r._field,
    _value: 1.0,
    priority: 0
  }))

// หากไม่มีข้อมูลใหม่จนจบช่วงที่เลือก ให้แสดง Disconnected
trailing = samples
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => int(v: stop) - int(v: r._time) > timeout)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: time(v: int(v: r._time) + timeout),
    _field: r._field,
    _value: 0.0,
    priority: 0
  }))

// รวมเฉพาะจุดเปลี่ยนสถานะ ไม่ส่งทุก sample กลับ Grafana
events = union(tables: [baseline, first_seen, disconnects, reconnects, trailing])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= start and r._time <= stop)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time", "priority"])
  |> unique(column: "_time")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> drop(columns: ["priority"])

// ส่งจุดสิ้นสุดเพื่อให้ Timeline แสดงสถานะจนถึงปลายช่วงเวลา
endpoints = events
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: stop}))

union(tables: [events, endpoints])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> unique(column: "_time")
  |> yield(name: "sensor_connectivity")

from(bucket: "plantcare")
  |> range(start: -3m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "plantcare_thermal" and
    r.data_source == "real" and
    r.device_id == "esp32_01" and
    (
      r._field == "t_max_c" or
      r._field == "delta_t_c"
    )
  )
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["_time"],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    exists r.t_max_c and
    exists r.delta_t_c
  )
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    _field: "thermal_exposure",
    _value:
      if r.t_max_c >= 35.0 then 2.0
      else if r.delta_t_c >= 2.0 then 1.0
      else 0.0
  }))
  |> yield(name: "thermal_exposure")
